svg.title: Seine
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Actual photographed marks traced to SVG rectangles; fine contours approximated and photographic texture removed. No randomized pattern. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/work/seine/; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
